entries.title: Echo Night

emulation.emulator: DuckStation; Sony PSOne Classics emulator for PS3/PSP/PS Vita
emulation.notes: Use DuckStation with an owned disc image for the primary capture route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS1 presentation with emulator-side resolution, PGXP, and filtering options.

primary.why: The original PlayStation release is the complete game, and DuckStation or similar PS1 emulation gives the best practical capture route from an owned copy; the PSOne Classic is an official convenience route but not a fidelity upgrade.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation copy on original hardware or use DuckStation with an owned disc image for cleaner capture. The PSOne Classic may be usable on PS3/PSP/PS Vita if already owned and accessible.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PSOne Classic is a digital rerelease of the PS1 game, not a remaster or remake.

entries.title: Echo Night 2: The Lord of Nightmares
entries.definitive_edition: Original Japanese PlayStation release via DuckStation

emulation.emulator: DuckStation; Sony PSOne Classics emulator for PS3/PSP
emulation.notes: Use DuckStation with an owned Japanese disc image for the primary capture route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS1 presentation with emulator-side resolution, PGXP, and filtering options.

primary.version: Original Japanese PlayStation release via DuckStation
primary.why: Echo Night 2 is a Japan-only PlayStation sequel with a later Japanese PSN rerelease; the original PS1 version through DuckStation is the highest-practical-fidelity route from an owned copy.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Japanese PlayStation copy on original hardware or use DuckStation with an owned disc image. The Japanese PSOne Classics release is an alternate official route where accessible.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PSN release is a PSOne Classics rerelease, not a remaster or remake.

entries.title: Echo Night: Beyond

emulation.notes: PCSX2 is the practical high-resolution capture route for an owned PS2 copy.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 assets and presentation with emulator-side resolution and filtering improvements.

primary.why: Echo Night: Beyond is a PlayStation 2-only sequel/spiritual continuation, so the original PS2 version through PCSX2 is the complete and highest-practical-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PS2 copy on original hardware or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for cleaner capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified.

entries.title: Echo Night: The First Voyage
entries.definitive_edition: Adventure Player bundled PSP release via PPSSPP

emulation.notes: Use PPSSPP with an owned Adventure Player copy for clean capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PSP presentation with emulator-side resolution and texture filtering improvements.

primary.version: Adventure Player bundled release via PPSSPP
primary.why: Echo Night: The First Voyage was released inside FromSoftware's Japan-only Adventure Player for PSP, so the PSP package through PPSSPP is the complete sourced route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Japanese PSP copy of Adventure Player and play through PSP hardware or PPSSPP. Fan-translation projects exist, but the archived guide should treat the original PSP package as the sourced release.

entries.remaster_caveats: No standalone official modern rerelease, remaster, or remake was identified; fan translations are not official editions.
